title: Side setback, walls above 7.1 m high (R50 and above)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: R5 and above, Wall height above 7.1m: 2.0m.

replaces.note: R2 10 m and R2.5 7.5 m unchanged; R5+ now by wall height only
wall length and major-opening dimensions dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Applies only where the building has walls 7.1 m high and above (condition on building.has_walls_over_7_1m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height. No pedestrian access way reduction above R25 in Chapter 3 (C3.4.1(ii), p33). R100-SL added to coding: Table 2.10a does not modify Table 3.4a setbacks, so the R5-and-above row applies, and Table 3A (draft p7) shows the 1m/1.5m/2m cells spanning R5 to R100-SL.

verified.note: Table 3.4a (p33) prints the bands as 'Wall height up to 3.5m', 'Wall height 3.6m to 7m' and 'Wall height above 7.1m', leaving 3.5-3.6 m and 7.0-7.1 m undefined; Table 3A (p7) prints the top band as '7.1m and above'. The encoded band conditions (> 3.5, > 7.0) are an inference. R100-SL: Table 3A (p7) prints the side setback cells spanning R5 to R100-SL; Table 2.10a (p26) does not modify C3.4.1.
